Hi Sofia / Acme procurement team —

Quick sync on timing so we can ensure bookings recognition for Q4. We have the signed order form, but finance needs the PO and an AP-issued invoice window to determine when revenue can be recognized. Two dependencies I want on the table:

- PO issuance date (we need the PO number before we can invoice)
- AP payment terms and expected invoice acceptance window (some customers require invoice processing batch dates)

I've attached a small PO timing calendar and our invoice window guidelines to show the cutoff dates that feed into our bookings recognition calendar. If the PO is issued by Nov 20 and AP confirms invoice acceptance within 7 business days, we can recognize the majority of the booking in November; otherwise recognition will likely shift into December / Q1.

Karthik — can you confirm whether Acme expects an invoice before deployment start or after go-live? Tessa — can you confirm the latest internal invoice cutoff we can accept for Nov recognition?

Proposed next step: Sofia, can you share the PO issue target and the correct AP contact for sending the invoice? If it's easier we can do a quick 20-minute call this week.

Thanks,

Marissa / Karthik / Sofia —

Confirming internal cutoffs: for November recognition we need a fully completed invoice (with PO number) submitted to AP by COB Nov 24 to be included in the November accounting run. If AP processes in batches and you expect them to only pick it up after the 25th, we will not be able to recognize in November. The critical path is: PO issued -> invoice submitted referencing PO -> AP confirms receipt and expected payment window.

Notes / options:
- If Acme can issue PO by Nov 19 and AP will accept invoices before Nov 24 we can recognize in November.
- If PO is Nov 22–25, ask AP to confirm expedited processing and provide an email confirmation upon receipt; we'll treat that as evidence for November recognition on a case-by-case basis.
- If the PO slips beyond Nov 25, bookings will be deferred to December recognition.

I've attached the invoice_window_guidelines.pdf with the accounting cutoffs. If helpful I can draft the exact invoice subject and SOW wording for Sofia to share with AP.

Thanks,
